finding.text: At 400 a row's meta line runs past the right edge and is cut off: "claude-s…" and the State cell are lost on the monorepo row, and the prompt preview stops mid-word with no ellipsis (layout 26, wrapping 23) — shots/…sessions/400.png, rows band (y≈840–870). layout.json reports overflow_x false, so the box clips rather than scrolls; the meta line should wrap (it is a control-style row) or drop the model to its own line.

The headers are now all sort toggles, but nothing shows it until one is clicked: plain text, no arrow or hover cue at rest (page 8) — shots/…/1200.png, header row. A faint ↕ on hover, or the default-order arrow on Cost, would make it self-evident.

`State` sorts "biggest first", so the first click puts idle sessions (1) above working ones (0) — the reverse of what a reader wants first (page.js `SORT_VALUE.state` + `natural_dir`). Make `state` start ascending.

`Session.read_text` in node now calls `Session.locate`, so a READ can rename a flat folder into its day folder, and an unknown id gets today's day cached. A read with a move side effect is surprising; doc/layout.md mentions it only for writers.

The diff deletes ~140 tracked `sessions/<id>/files.jsonl` listings and `session-place.mjs` `rmSync`s them. They are server-generated and now gitignored, so nothing is lost, but "Never destructive" asks that the landing report say so.

At 3440 the Name column takes ~60% of the grid while Updated / Duration / Role sit in ~70px tracks (shots/…/3440.png, rows band; layout.json empty 0.75 at 3440). Not wrong, but a Name ceiling would let the numbers breathe.
Previous round's fix (empty shots, no index) is resolved: every width now shows 603 sessions and priced rows.

Child sessions are not nested by path (requirements, Addendum 8, "literally subdirectories of the parent's directory") and "every session gets a proper name going forward" is not built: the diff only nests rows in the grid from session-tree.json, and priorities.md/layout.md list both as "not built / still to do". The reason is written down (a child can start a day later), but the owner's ask is unmet.

"In flight" has two definitions that disagree: `is_in_flight` counts an idle-but-live Servex agent as in flight, but the state column's ▶ uses `WORKING_STATES` (working/active) only, so rows in the "In flight now" strip show a quiet • (diff, page.js `row_view` vs `is_in_flight`). The state flashing the owner reported can reappear as a mismatch.

The new "In flight now" strip repeats the same rows as the grid and pushes the grid down: at 1920 and 3440 only the first few grid rows appear below the strip (shots/127-0-0-1-50850-framework-ai-sessions/1920.png, bands 2-3). The owner asked for a compact grid and a filter next to the checkboxes, not a second section (CLAUDE.md law 6, law 4).
Before/after bytes and requests for the Sessions page (requirements item 4) are not in the diff or the shots; not measured here.
The shots folder holds two runs. Port 63872 shows the old page (big tiles, State last); port 50850 shows the new one. I judged the 50850 run. Check the other is not what gets kept.

page.js indentation is off in the controls block (the `const tags` line sits after the new in-flight label) and in the poll/stream block. It parses, but confirm the tag filter still renders inside its intended condition.
`session-place.mjs` still deletes the stray `files.jsonl` listings, which is outside "never destructive". It is documented as regenerable noise, so a note only.
The 400 shot has 43% empty and the two drawer rail buttons wrap to 3.2 lines (layout.json wraps); the rail wrap is older than this change.
